description: List the files attached to a work item (not files in its discussion comments): id, name, mediaType, size, clientVisible, createdAt (upload time), originalCreatedAt (when given at upload) and uploadedByUid. ONE PAGE per call (50 by default, 100 max); when meta.hasMore is true, pass meta.nextCursor back as cursor. Download a file with GET /api/v1/control/work/{itemId}/files/{fileId}.
name: anyforge_list_work_item_files
title: List work item files
